title: Freedom Movement in Punjab Recall Quiz

questions.q: Who was the founder of the Namdhari (Kuka) Movement?
questions.qPa: ਨਾਮਧਾਰੀ (ਕੂਕਾ) ਲਹਿਰ ਦੇ ਮੋਢੀ ਕੌਣ ਸਨ?
questions.explanation: Baba Ram Singh founded the Namdhari movement at Bhaini Sahib.

questions.q: In which town were 66 Kukas blown away from cannons in 1872?
questions.explanation: 66 Kukas were brutally executed by the British at Malerkotla.

questions.q: Where was the Ghadar Party founded in 1913?
questions.qPa: 1913 ਵਿੱਚ ਗ਼ਦਰ ਪਾਰਟੀ ਦੀ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: The Ghadar Party was founded in San Francisco, USA.

questions.q: Who was the founding President of the Ghadar Party?
questions.explanation: Baba Sohan Singh Bhakna was the founding President, while Lala Hardayal was the General Secretary/key intellectual leader.

questions.q: Who chartered the Japanese ship Komagata Maru in 1914?
questions.explanation: Baba Gurdit Singh, a Singapore-based businessman, chartered the ship to take Indians to Canada.

questions.q: What was the exact date of the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre?
questions.qPa: ਜਲ੍ਹਿਆਂਵਾਲਾ ਬਾਗ ਦੇ ਸਾਕੇ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਕੀ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: The Jallianwala Bagh Massacre took place on the day of Baisakhi, 13 April 1919.

questions.q: The people at Jallianwala Bagh had gathered to protest against the arrest of which leaders?
options: Lala Lajpat Rai and Ajit Singh
Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew and Dr. Satyapal
Sohan Singh Bhakna and Lala Hardayal
questions.explanation: The gathering was protesting the Rowlatt Act and the arrests of local leaders Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew and Dr. Satyapal.

questions.q: Which organization was founded by Bhagat Singh in 1926?
questions.explanation: Bhagat Singh founded the Naujawan Bharat Sabha in 1926 to encourage the youth to join the freedom struggle.
